• Led global network operations for General Electric (GE) across 3 regions (APAC, EMEA,

implementation, testing, and handover.

best practices.

performance and network resiliency. 
• Demonstrated deep expertise in WAN, MPLS, Policy-Based Routing (PBR), VPNs, LAN/WAN, 
and network security. 
• Delivered executive-level reports covering availability, incident trends, SLA compliance, and risk 
analysis.
